description: This is a test class for the LicenseDao component within the OrangeHRM system. It contains unit tests to verify CRUD operations and other methods related to License data access, including adding, editing, retrieving by ID or name, listing, and deleting licenses. The class uses test fixtures and mock data to validate the behavior of LicenseDao methods.

classes.name: LicenseDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the functionality of LicenseDao operations in the OrangeHRM system's admin plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, setting up the LicenseDao instance and loading test data using the fixture file.

methods.name: testAddLicense
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new License entity and verifies its persistence.

methods.name: testEditLicense
methods.description: Tests updating an existing License entity and verifies the update.

methods.name: testGetLicenseById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a License entity by its ID.

methods.name: testGetLicenseList
methods.description: Checks that the license list returned matches expected count and types.

methods.name: testDeleteLicenses
methods.description: Verifies deleting multiple License records by their IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests behavior when attempting to delete a non-existent record.

methods.name: testIsExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Tests the case-insensitive check of existing license names.

methods.name: testGetLicenseByName
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of License entities by name, including handling of whitespace and case variations.
